ido.question: An online form accepts integer ages from 11 to 18 inclusive. Ask again until an age is in range, then display Accepted.
ido.scaffold:
age = int(input("Age?"))
while _____
    age = _____
endwhile
print("Accepted")

steps.title: Read an integer age
steps.explanation: The example assumes the user enters an integer. The permitted range is 11–18.

steps.title: Identify invalid values
steps.explanation: Use OR because an age below 11 or above 18 is invalid.
steps.code:
age = int(input("Age?"))
while age < 11 OR age > 18

steps.title: Ask again
steps.explanation: Read another age inside the loop until it is valid.
steps.code:
age = int(input("Age?"))
while age < 11 OR age > 18
    age = int(input("Try again:"))
endwhile

steps.title: Test the boundaries
steps.explanation: 10 and 19 are rejected; 11 and 18 are accepted. This validates age, not identity.
steps.code:
age = int(input("Age?"))
while age < 11 OR age > 18
    age = int(input("Try again:"))
endwhile
print("Accepted")
